source: Annex #8B — Orion Pirate / WYN / Barbarian Optional Weapons Cost Chart (Captain's Module G3: Annexes, rev 4/13/09), G15.4
note: Excludes the X-SHIPS ONLY and SIMULATOR USE ONLY sub-sections (out of scope). Field defaults: positions=[CENTERLINE,WING], mountsRequired=1, maxSizeClass=6 (no size bar), available=true, yearAvailable=0 (always). maxSizeClass=3 encodes the (double-dagger) 'not on size-4-or-smaller' rule; positions=[CENTERLINE] encodes (delta) 'not in wing mounts'; mountsRequired=2 encodes (asterisk) 'two adjacent centerline mounts'. available=false covers both the (infinity) 'never' weapons and the niche (section-sign captured-only) / (T Tholian-home-galaxy) options — the reason is in notes.
